why: The only first release of the three. Google's own post gives checkable figures on price, latency and limits, and several outlets covered it within a day, with details that differ and are worth sorting out. No earlier post covers decision models.

set_aside.why: Solid product news with an independent benchmark, but narrower in audience; good material for the Sunday recap.
A wider rollout of a model unveiled in late October: the larger story, but the less new one.
